message.description: The message string to be scrolled across the screen.

position.description: Scroll line position. 'top' for top line, 'bottom' for bottom line.

foreground_color.description: Foreground text color. One of: black, gray, red, brightred, green, brightgreen, brown, yellow, blue, brightblue, magenta, brightmagenta, cyan, brightcyan, lightgray, white.

background_color.description: Background text color. One of: black, gray, red, brightred, green, brightgreen, brown, yellow, blue, brightblue, magenta, brightmagenta, cyan, brightcyan, lightgray, white.

delay.description: Delay in seconds between display updates. Controls scroll speed. Can be decimal.

shm_id.description: SysV shared memory segment ID (numeric string) to read messages from. Empty string means use MESSAGE variable directly.

shm_size.description: Size of the shared memory segment in characters.

check_interval.description: Minimum time in seconds between checks of the shared memory segment for a new message.
